patterns.note: Fixed oversized brand name acts as a transparent overlay at the top, with main content scrolling underneath it.

Content sections scroll vertically, revealing new elements from the bottom, while the large brand name at the top remains fixed and content scrolls behind it. A small circular logo and a repeating text strip also stick to the left and bottom edges respectively after initial scroll.
High contrast between a warm, light background and dark, bold typography, accented by a vibrant red for calls to action.
A dominant, extra-bold, uppercase sans-serif display font is used for the brand name, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels.
Product and portfolio showcases utilize highly varied, asymmetrical grid layouts with mixed image sizes and occasional text overlays, creating an editorial magazine feel.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero is used, with a large, fixed brand name overlaid on top. This brand name uses a blend mode or transparency to allow the video content to show through as it scrolls behind it.

Sections are revealed with a simple scroll-up effect, where new content appears from the bottom of the viewport. A small circular brand mark and a repeating text strip are implemented as sticky elements, appearing after initial scroll and remaining fixed on the left and bottom edges respectively.
Product and portfolio items are presented in a dynamic, non-uniform grid, often with images bleeding to the edge or overlapping, creating a collage-like effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, extra-bold uppercase display heading (~4-5x body) with smaller, uppercase labels and a clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with some subtle rounding on product images and interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing in hero and text sections, transitioning to a more dense but still visually distinct product grid.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the oversized, fixed brand name at the top, which acts as a transparent overlay that content scrolls *behind*, creating a unique sense of depth and visual hierarchy. This, combined with the editorial-style, asymmetrical product grids and sticky side/bottom elements, elevates it beyond a standard marketing template.
